turns.query: From Company Facts, build the candidate set of JNJ annual Form 10-K facts reported in USD for revenue from contracts with customers excluding assessed tax over the exact period 2022-01-03 through 2023-01-01. Report the number of fact rows, distinct accessions and distinct reported values. Explain why the exact duration identifies the historical observation even when a later comparative presentation carries a different filing fiscal-year label.

Join that candidate set to SEC filing metadata. For each knowledge cutoff, 2023-06-30 23:59:59 and 2024-06-30 23:59:59, keep non-amended filings accepted by EDGAR no later than the cutoff and select the one with the latest acceptance timestamp; if timestamps tie, choose the lexicographically smallest accession. For each cutoff report the supporting accession, its acceptance timestamp and the revenue in USD billions. Explain what the structured tables establish about the two presentations and what they do not establish about the cause of the change.
